entries.text: TPC-DI ETL loads now bulk-insert DataFrames through DuckDB registration or PostgreSQL COPY, and the SCD Type 2 processor applies non-SCD updates with set-based statements instead of per-row loops.
details: Measured on DuckDB at scale factor 10, the historical load phase dropped from about 1.6s to about 0.02s with identical table contents and validation results.
Missing string values in loaded DataFrames are now stored as NULL on DuckDB instead of the text 'nan'.
PostgreSQL COPY writes whole-number float columns, such as integer columns that hold NULLs, without a decimal point.
